remarks: Looking to rent a single-family house instead of a condo or apartment? This wonderful three-bedroom colonial in the heart of Norwalk offers the perfect combination of charm and convenience. Enjoy all that Norwalk has to offer with nearby Cranbury Park, Calf Pasture Beach, and Historic South Norwalk, while commuters will appreciate the short drive to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and Metro North train stations. The home features a large private deck ideal for summer barbecues and entertaining, along with a fenced side yard. Inside, the kitchen boasts some brand new appliances, granite countertops, tile flooring, opening to a dining area and a spacious living room filled with natural light from multiple windows, including two picture windows. Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms with hardwood floors; the primary bedroom includes two closets and a ceiling fan. Additional highlights include a pull-down attic for storage, a conveniently located main-floor laundry closet with a new washing machine. Other new appliances include microwave, Range/stove and Refrigerator, a new hot water heater and a newer furnace. In addition, there is a new bathroom vanity and cabinet and the hardwood floors have been re-done. Interior paint will be refreshed. Pets may be considered, and excellent credit is required. A rare find in this price range and truly a great place to call home! Agents please see remarks.
